overview: The Merchant Promenade is the commercial heart of Sanctus Seru, where sanctioned trade occurs under strict doctrinal oversight.
history: Established to centralize commerce and enforce purity standards.
Purity-screened storefronts were added to prevent ideological corruption.
Decree-regulated merchant stalls were introduced to control goods.
Praetorian oversight routes were formalized to maintain order.
hooks: A merchant stall reports a decree violation.
A purity storefront experiences a resonance flare.
A Praetorian officer requests assistance with a trade edict.
A shipment of sanctioned goods goes missing.
